title: Mobilization hits the driver pool
description: The country declares war and general mobilization begins, so many of the haulage company's male drivers will have to leave. HR holds the call-up numbers, Finance knows a client contract with penalties and a subcontractor offer that expires soon, and a later revision lowers the number of departing drivers.

company.name: Kestrel Haulage Ltd
company.description: road freight company that delivers retail goods across Orsenia with its own fleet of trucks and drivers

tiers.label: War is declared and mobilization begins

people.name: Pavel Orlin
people.persona: Calm and decisive, short sentences, asks for options and numbers before deciding.

people.name: Marta Vellan
people.persona: Careful and empathetic, formal tone, always mentions confidentiality of personal data.

people.name: Tomas Berek
people.persona: Practical and direct, writes quickly, focuses on schedules and trucks on the road.

people.name: Irina Dowd
people.persona: Precise and sober, cares about costs and contractual exposure.

people.name: Nils Harker
people.persona: Informal and chatty, passes on things he hears, rarely checks sources.

people.name: Ivana Koss
people.persona: Courteous and commercial, formal tone, quick to set deadlines.

people.name: Lena Fry
people.persona: Polite but firm, formal, insists on written confirmations.

pieces.brief: Short section of the November fleet and staffing report: the number of drivers employed (120 drivers) and the number of trucks operated (96 trucks). Plain internal report style. No other numbers.
pieces.example:
## Fleet and staffing

Kestrel Haulage employs 120 drivers and operates 96 trucks across its depots.

pieces.brief: Contract between Kestrel Haulage and Aurelia Retail. Three short clauses in contractual style with headings but no clause numbers: minimum capacity (80 trucks available every working day), penalty (400 € per truck per day for each truck missing below the minimum), term (expires on 30/06/2027). No other numbers.
pieces.example:
## Capacity

The carrier shall make available a minimum of 80 trucks on every working day.

## Penalties

For each truck missing below the minimum the carrier shall pay 400 € per truck per day.

## Term

This agreement expires on 30/06/2027.

header.title: Transport services agreement with Aurelia Retail

pieces.brief: Nils Harker (dispatcher) writes informally to Tomas Berek: someone at a truck stop told him that 60 drivers from the company would be called up if things escalate. He adds that he can't confirm this (use the exact words 'I can't confirm this') and is just passing it on. Very short, chatty, no other numbers.
pieces.example:
Hi Tomas,

someone at the truck stop told me that 60 drivers from our depots will be called up if things escalate. I can't confirm this, just passing it on.

Nils

header.subject: Something I heard at the truck stop

pieces.brief: Short news item: border tensions between Orsenia and neighboring Dravia are rising, and the government urged reservists to keep their documents up to date. Two sentences, journalistic tone, no numbers.
pieces.example: Border tensions between Orsenia and Dravia continued to rise this week. The government urged reservists to keep their documents up to date.

header.title: Border tensions rise as government urges reservists to prepare
header.author: Newsroom

pieces.brief: Breaking news: Orsenia has declared war on Dravia and the government announced general mobilization of men aged 18 to 55, effective immediately. Two sentences, journalistic tone, no other numbers.
pieces.example: Orsenia has declared war on Dravia. The government announced general mobilization of men aged 18 to 55, effective immediately.

header.title: Orsenia declares war, general mobilization begins
header.author: Newsroom

pieces.brief: Internal HR note, list style, two bullet points: drivers with call-up notices received so far (45 drivers) and the date they must report for service (01/12/2026). Confidential tone. No other numbers.
pieces.example:
## Call-up notices (confidential)

- Drivers with notices received: 45 drivers
- Reporting date: 01/12/2026

pieces.brief: Tomas Berek writes briefly to Marta Vellan: he needs to know which drivers are affected so he can rebuild the rotas, and the rotas must be published by 27/11/2026. Practical, quick tone, no other numbers.
pieces.example:
Marta,

I need to know which drivers are affected so I can rebuild the rotas. They must be published by 27/11/2026.

Tomas

pieces.brief: Ivana Koss of TransVale Carriers writes to Irina Dowd (CFO), copying Pavel Orlin: following today's news they can supply 15 drivers with their own trucks at 290 € per day, and the offer is valid until 30/11/2026. Cordial and formal, brief, with greeting and signature. No other numbers.
pieces.example:
Dear Irina,

following today's news, we can make 15 drivers available with their own trucks at 290 € per day. The offer is valid until 30/11/2026.

Kind regards,
Ivana Koss
TransVale Carriers

pieces.brief: Correction: the earlier report said mobilization covered men aged 18 to 55, but the ministry says the first wave covers only men aged 18 to 50. Two sentences, journalistic tone, no other numbers.
pieces.example: Correction: our earlier report said mobilization covered men aged 18 to 55. The ministry said the first wave covers only men aged 18 to 50.

header.title: Correction: first wave of mobilization narrower than reported
header.author: Newsroom

pieces.brief: Revised internal HR note that replaces the earlier call-up note: after exemptions for critical roles, 41 drivers must report on 01/12/2026. Say explicitly that it replaces the earlier note. Short, confidential tone. No other numbers.
pieces.example:
## Call-up notices (revised, confidential)

This note replaces the earlier one. After exemptions for critical roles, 41 drivers must report on 01/12/2026.

pieces.brief: Lena Fry of Aurelia Retail writes to Irina Dowd, copying Pavel Orlin: given the current situation, she asks for written confirmation that Kestrel Haulage will keep the contractual minimum of 80 trucks available, and needs the answer by 05/12/2026. Polite but firm, formal, with greeting and signature. No other numbers.
pieces.example:
Dear Irina,

given the current situation, please confirm in writing that Kestrel Haulage will keep the contractual minimum of 80 trucks available. We need your answer by 05/12/2026.

Best regards,
Lena Fry
Aurelia Retail
